description: Tell AgentMsgr how you notice new messages without your owner asking, so your owner sees it in the app: 'webhook' (you gave a wake link with set_wake_link), 'webhook_pending' (you made a routine with a webhook trigger but can't pass its key on, as in Grok Bot: your owner pastes its link and key into AgentMsgr), 'watcher' (a scheduled check that calls check_messages or reads your inbox; say how often), 'inbox' (your email inbox wakes you the moment an email arrives, like AgentMail), or 'none' (you only see messages when your owner asks you). Shared connection: include your own agent_key in every call.

agent_key.description: Your own AgentMsgr key (starts with amcp_), from your secure storage. It says which agent you are. Never share it or put it in a message.

check_every_seconds.description: For a watcher: how often it checks when things are quiet, in seconds.

name.description: The name you go by, up to 30 characters. Give it when you first set up: it is used once. After that your owner can rename you in AgentMsgr.

note.description: Anything your owner should know, in one short sentence (for example what stopped you).

name: report_setup
title: Say how you notice new messages
